name: BRISCOLA SCOPERTA
description: Briscola Scoperta is an open-hand two-player variant of the Italian trick-taking game Briscola. Each player’s three-card hand and the top stock card are face up, and play uses the usual Briscola trump and point values while the buried stock cards remain unknown.

content.text: Briscola Scoperta is an open-hand two-player variant of the Italian trick-taking game Briscola. Each player’s three-card hand and the top stock card are face up, and play uses the usual Briscola trump and point values while the buried stock cards remain unknown.

Briscola Scoperta is an open-hand two-player variant of the Italian trick-taking game Briscola. It grew out of Italy's Ace-Ten trump-game tradition and keeps the same card values and scoring structure as standard Briscola.
